## March Rainfall event 2026

Shinyapp with slider

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(terra)
library(leaflet)
library(viridis)
library(raster)

raster_dir <- "C:/Users/Public/DS434-SpacialAnalysis/HCDP_data"
tif_files <- sort(list.files(raster_dir, pattern = "rainfall_new_day_statewide_se_2026_03_\\d{2}\\.tif$",
                             full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE))

dates <- seq(as.Date("2026-03-01"), as.Date("2026-03-24"), by = "day")

ui <- fluidPage(
  tags$head(tags$style(HTML("
    body, .container-fluid { background-color: #1a1a2e; color: white; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    #map { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; z-index: 1; }

    #slider-panel {
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 40px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      z-index: 1000;
      background: rgba(15, 15, 40, 0.85);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 20px 40px 10px 40px;
      width: 80vw;
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.3);
    }

    #date_label {
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: bold;
      color: #a78bfa;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
    }

    .irs--shiny .irs-bar { background: #7c3aed; border-top: 1px solid #7c3aed; border-bottom: 1px solid #7c3aed; }
    .irs--shiny .irs-line { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); }
    .irs--shiny .irs-handle { background: #a78bfa; border: 2px solid white; width: 22px; height: 22px; top: 22px; }
    .irs--shiny .irs-from, .irs--shiny .irs-to, .irs--shiny .irs-single { display: none !important; }
    .irs--shiny .irs-min, .irs--shiny .irs-max { display: none !important; }
    .irs--shiny .irs-grid-text { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); font-size: 11px; }

    #title-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      top: 20px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      z-index: 1000;
      color: white;
      font-size: 26px;
      font-weight: bold;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
      background: rgba(15,15,40,0.6);
      padding: 10px 30px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
    }
  "))),

  div(id = "title-overlay", "🌧 Hawaii Daily Rainfall — March 2026"),
  leafletOutput("map", width = "100%", height = "100vh"),

  div(id = "slider-panel",
    div(id = "date_label", uiOutput("date_display")),
    sliderInput("day", label = NULL,
                min = 1, max = 24, value = 1, step = 1, width = "100%",
                animate = animationOptions(interval = 300, loop = TRUE))
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  current_raster <- reactive({
    req(input$day)
    r <- rast(tif_files[input$day])
    project(r, "EPSG:4326")
  })

  output$date_display <- renderUI({
    req(input$day)
    span(format(dates[input$day], "%B %d, %Y"))
  })

  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    leaflet() %>%
      addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.DarkMatter) %>%
      setView(lng = -157.5, lat = 20.5, zoom = 7)
  })

  observeEvent(input$day, {
    req(current_raster())
    r <- current_raster()
    vals <- values(r, na.rm = TRUE)

    pal <- colorNumeric(
      palette = viridis(100, option = "D"),
      domain = c(0, max(vals)),
      na.color = "transparent"
    )

    leafletProxy("map") %>%
      clearImages() %>%
      clearControls() %>%
      addRasterImage(raster::raster(r), colors = pal, opacity = 0.85) %>%
      addLegend(
        position = "bottomright",
        pal = pal,
        values = vals,
        title = "Rainfall (mm)",
        labFormat = labelFormat(suffix = " mm")
      )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(terra)
library(leaflet)
library(viridis)

# ── File list ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
raster_dir <- "C:/Users/jaydo/OneDrive/Desktop/ds434/DS434-SpacialAnalysis/march_2026/rainfall/new/day/statewide/se/2026/03"
tif_files  <- sort(list.files(raster_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE))
dates      <- seq(as.Date("2026-03-01"), by = "day", length.out = length(tif_files))

ui <- fluidPage(
  tags$head(tags$style(HTML("
    body, .container-fluid { background-color: #1a1a2e; color: white; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    }
    #date_label { text-align: center; font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold;
      color: #a78bfa; margin-bottom: 8px; letter-spacing: 2px; }
    .irs--shiny .irs-bar { background: #7c3aed; border-top: 1px solid #7c3aed; border-bottom: 1px solid #7c3aed; }
    .irs--shiny .irs-line { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); }
    .irs--shiny .irs-handle { background: #a78bfa; border: 2px solid white; width: 22px; height: 22px; top: 22px; }
    .irs--shiny .irs-from, .irs--shiny .irs-to, .irs--shiny .irs-single { display: none !important; }
    .irs--shiny .irs-min, .irs--shiny .irs-max { display: none !important; }
    .irs--shiny .irs-grid-text { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); font-size: 11px; }
    #title-overlay {
      position: fixed; top: 20px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
      z-index: 1000; color: white; font-size: 26px; font-weight: bold;
      letter-spacing: 2px; text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
      background: rgba(15,15,40,0.6); padding: 10px 30px;
      border-radius: 12px; backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
    }
  "))),
  div(id = "title-overlay", "🌧 Hawaii Daily Rainfall — March 2026"),
  leafletOutput("map", width = "100%", height = "100vh"),
  div(id = "slider-panel",
    div(id = "date_label", uiOutput("date_display")),
    sliderInput("day", label = NULL,
                min   = 1,
                max   = length(tif_files),
                value = 1,
                step  = 1,
                width = "100%",
                ticks = TRUE),   # animation removed
    div(style = "display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: -5px; padding: 0 2px;",
        lapply(seq(1, length(dates), by = 2), function(i) {
          div(style = "color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); font-size: 10px; text-align: center;",
              format(dates[i], "%b %d"))
        })
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  current_raster <- reactive({
    req(input$day)
    req(input$day <= length(tif_files))
    r <- rast(tif_files[input$day])
    project(r, "EPSG:4326")
  })

  output$date_display <- renderUI({
    req(input$day)
    span(format(dates[input$day], "%B %d, %Y"))
  })

  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    leaflet() %>%
      addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.DarkMatter) %>%
      setView(lng = -157.5, lat = 20.5, zoom = 7)
  })

  observeEvent(input$day, {
    req(current_raster())
    r    <- current_raster()
    vals <- values(r, na.rm = TRUE)
    pal  <- colorNumeric(
      palette  = viridis(100, option = "D"),
      domain   = c(0, max(vals)),
      na.color = "transparent"
    )
    leafletProxy("map") %>%
      clearImages() %>%
      clearControls() %>%
      addRasterImage(raster::raster(r), colors = pal, opacity = 0.85) %>%
      addLegend(
        position  = "bottomright",
        pal       = pal,
        values    = vals,
        title     = "Rainfall (mm)",
        labFormat = labelFormat(suffix = " mm")
      )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

**Graphs (Partial station data)**

Reading the CSV

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

df <- read.csv("C:/Users/jaydo/OneDrive/Desktop/ds434/DS434-SpacialAnalysis/march_2026/rainfall/new/day/statewide/partial/station_data/2026/03/rainfall_new_day_statewide_partial_station_data_2026_03.csv")

# ── Pivot to long format ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
date_cols <- names(df)[grepl("X2026", names(df))]

df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(date_cols),
               names_to  = "date",
               values_to = "rainfall") %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(gsub("X", "", date), format = "%Y.%m.%d"))
```

Total Daily Rainfall across all stations

```{r}
df_daily <- df_long %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(mean_rainfall = mean(rainfall, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(df_daily, aes(x = date, y = mean_rainfall)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4a90d9", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(colour = "white", size = 2) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %d", date_breaks = "2 days") +
  labs(title = "Average Daily Rainfall — March 2026",
       subtitle = "Mean across all stations",
       x = "Date", y = "Rainfall (mm)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.x       = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a2e", colour = NA),
        panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a2e", colour = NA),
        text              = element_text(colour = "white"),
        axis.text         = element_text(colour = "white"),
        panel.grid        = element_line(colour = "grey30"))
```

Heatmap

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# ── Load ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df <- read.csv("C:/Users/jaydo/OneDrive/Desktop/ds434/DS434-SpacialAnalysis/march_2026/rainfall/new/day/statewide/partial/station_data/2026/03/rainfall_new_day_statewide_partial_station_data_2026_03.csv")

# ── Pivot to long format ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
date_cols <- names(df)[grepl("X2026", names(df))]

df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols      = all_of(date_cols),
               names_to  = "date",
               values_to = "rainfall") %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(gsub("X", "", date), format = "%Y.%m.%d"))

# ── Station totals ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df_stations <- df_long %>%
  group_by(Station.Name, Island) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(rainfall, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  head(10)

df_daily <- df_long %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(mean_rainfall = mean(rainfall, na.rm = TRUE))

df_heat <- df_long %>%
  filter(Station.Name %in% df_stations$Station.Name)

cat("✅ All data objects created successfully\n")
cat("df_long rows:", nrow(df_long), "\n")
cat("df_stations rows:", nrow(df_stations), "\n")
cat("df_heat rows:", nrow(df_heat), "\n")
```

```{r}
df_heat <- df_long %>%
```

ggiraph

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggiraph)
library(maps)
library(sf)
library(patchwork)

# ── Hawaii basemap ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
hawaii_map <- st_as_sf(map("world", region = "USA:Hawaii", plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE)) %>%
  st_set_crs(4326)

# ── Add tooltip and data_id to heatmap data ───────────────────────────────────
df_heat <- df_long %>%
  filter(Station.Name %in% df_stations$Station.Name) %>%
  mutate(
    rainfall_in = round(rainfall * 0.0394, 2),
    tooltip     = paste0("Station: ", Station.Name,
                         "\nDate: ", format(date, "%b %d"),
                         "\nRainfall: ", rainfall_in, " in"),
    data_id     = Station.Name  # links heatmap to map
  )

# ── Add tooltip and data_id to station map points ────────────────────────────
df_map_points <- df %>%
  filter(Station.Name %in% df_stations$Station.Name) %>%
  mutate(
    total_in = round(rowSums(select(., starts_with("X2026")), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.0394, 2),
    tooltip  = paste0("Station: ", Station.Name,
                      "\nIsland: ", Island,
                      "\nTotal Rainfall: ", total_in, " in"),
    data_id  = Station.Name  # must match heatmap data_id
  )

# ── Heatmap ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_heat <- ggplot(df_heat, aes(x = date,
                               y = reorder(Station.Name, rainfall, sum),
                               fill = rainfall_in,
                               tooltip = tooltip,
                               data_id = data_id)) +
  geom_tile_interactive(colour = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "D", na.value = "grey30", name = "in") +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %d", date_breaks = "2 days") +
  labs(title = "Daily Rainfall Heatmap — Top 10 Stations",
       x = "Date", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a2e", colour = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a2e", colour = NA),
        text             = element_text(colour = "white"),
        axis.text        = element_text(colour = "white"),
        panel.grid       = element_line(colour = "grey10"),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a2e"),
        plot.title       = element_text(colour = "white", face = "bold"))

# ── Hawaii map with stations ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = hawaii_map, fill = "#2d4a6e", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    data    = df_map_points,
    aes(x = LON, y = LAT,
        colour  = total_in,
        tooltip = tooltip,
        data_id = data_id),
    size  = 4,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "D", name = "Total (in)") +
  labs(title = "Station Locations — Top 10",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a2e", colour = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a2e", colour = NA),
        text             = element_text(colour = "white"),
        axis.text        = element_text(colour = "white"),
        panel.grid       = element_line(colour = "grey20"),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a2e"),
        plot.title       = element_text(colour = "white", face = "bold"))

# ── Combine and render with linking ──────────────────────────────────────────
girafe(
  ggobj = p_heat + p_map,
  width_svg  = 14,
  height_svg = 5,
  options = list(
    opts_hover(css = "fill:orange; stroke:white; stroke-width:1.5; r:6px;"),
    opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.2;"),
    opts_selection(
      type = "single",
      css  = "fill:orange; stroke:white; stroke-width:2;"
    ),
    opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE),
    opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
  )
)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggiraph)
library(maps)
library(sf)
library(patchwork)

# ── Hawaii basemap (no CRS override) ─────────────────────────────────────────
hawaii_map <- st_as_sf(
  map("world", region = "USA:Hawaii", plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE)
)

# ── Heatmap data (station-level linking) ─────────────────────────────────────
df_heat <- df_long %>%
  filter(Station.Name %in% df_stations$Station.Name) %>%
  mutate(
    Station.Name = as.character(Station.Name),
    date = as.Date(date),

    rainfall_in = round(rainfall * 0.0394, 2),

    tooltip = paste0(
      "Station: ", Station.Name,
      "\nDate: ", format(date, "%b %d"),
      "\nRainfall: ", rainfall_in, " in"
    ),

    # IMPORTANT: station-level ID for linking
    data_id = Station.Name
  )

# ── Map data (must match heatmap IDs exactly) ────────────────────────────────
df_map_points <- df %>%
  filter(Station.Name %in% df_stations$Station.Name) %>%
  mutate(
    Station.Name = as.character(Station.Name),

    total_in = round(
      rowSums(select(., starts_with("X2026")), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.0394, 2
    ),

    tooltip = paste0(
      "Station: ", Station.Name,
      "\nIsland: ", Island,
      "\nTotal Rainfall: ", total_in, " in"
    ),

    data_id = Station.Name
  )

# ── Heatmap ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_heat <- ggplot(
  df_heat,
  aes(
    x = date,
    y = reorder(Station.Name, rainfall, sum),
    fill = rainfall_in,
    tooltip = tooltip,
    data_id = data_id
  )
) +
  geom_tile_interactive(colour = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "D", na.value = "grey30") +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %d", date_breaks = "2 days") +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Rainfall — Top 10 Stations",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a2e", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a2e", colour = NA),
    text = element_text(colour = "white"),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "white"),
    panel.grid = element_line(colour = "grey10"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "white")
  )

# ── Map ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = hawaii_map,
    fill = "#2d4a6e",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    data = df_map_points,
    aes(
      x = LON,
      y = LAT,
      colour = total_in,
      tooltip = tooltip,
      data_id = data_id
    ),
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "D") +
  labs(title = "Stations") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a2e", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a2e", colour = NA),
    text = element_text(colour = "white"),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "white", size = 12),
    panel.grid = element_line(colour = "grey20"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# ── Combine plots ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
combined_plot <- p_heat + p_map + plot_layout(widths = c(1.6, 1))

# ── Render in RStudio Viewer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
girafe(
  ggobj = combined_plot,
  width_svg = 11.5,
  height_svg = 6,
  options = list(
```
